completeness.reason: Covers GetKeyType, RobotsMatcher (OneAgentAllowedByRobots, AllowedByRobots, IsValidUserAgentToObey, status accessors), RobotsParsingReporter (valid_directives, unused_directives, last_line_seen, parse_results), and ParseRobotsTxt. unambiguity.reason: The KeyType enum values and the basic API shapes are defined. However, the matching rules for wildcards (*), end-of-path anchors ($), precedence between allow and disallow, and specific-agent vs global-agent precedence are not described. An implementation without knowledge of RFC 9309 semantics would lack the rules to pass wildcard and precedence tests.

testability.reason: Basic tests (empty robots allows all, DisallowAll, named agent rules) are supportable from the prompt. But tests for wildcard path matching, dollar anchors, longest-match wins, allow-wins-on-tie, and specific-agent overriding the global '*' rule require semantics not in the prompt. These are tested in the blackbox test suite.
